name: Dave Gargiulo
features: olive skin, black hair, brown eyes, Italian-American features, athletic build, weathered features, some wrinkles, goatee
bio:
An American gearhead from Detroit who grew up in his father's garage. Dave's mechanical empathy means he always gets the most out of his machinery.

Always talking about his beloved Mexico... Mexico this, Mexico that... He often gets invited to shut the fuck up and take his indian ass right back to his damn country. He didn't do that and, of course, never will.
